words.gloss: in the execution of a task

literal: In the execution of a task, him who thinks differently of the friendship of the one who has the capability for that task, Fortune will depart from.
translation: Fortune will depart from a leader who doubts the loyalty of an efficient worker who is fully dedicated to his task.
modern: ஒரு தொழிலைச் செய்வதில் வல்லமை உடையவனுடைய நட்பை, வேறுபட்டு (சந்தேகப்பட்டு) நினைக்கும் தலைவனை விட்டுச் செல்வம் நீங்கும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the danger of harboring suspicion against capable and dedicated workers. 'Vinaiyutaiyan' refers to a person who has the skill and drive to execute a task. If a leader doubts ('veraka ninaippan') the loyalty or friendship ('kenmai') of such a worker while they are engaged in their work ('vinaikkan'), the Goddess of Fortune ('Thiru') will abandon that leader. Trust is essential for successful delegation, and groundless suspicion only drives away prosperity.
